items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: And I played with Hal Kristoff quite a bit mostly.

ctx.x: No we only got part a year man. Part a year man. It's going to take two or three sessions for him. We want to play some records for him up at Tulane and stuff and get him to tell us about the bands on the records. But who did you play your first job with?

Well my first job is professional so you sort of speak is the way you get some money for it. We had a little outfit we broke off and organized on our own. And they was mostly I think we played for the Patterson's and we had one of the fellas who was a little more advanced. He's one of the greats around town. Now he's a tenor man. You might know. His name is John Patterson. I don't know him. I don't know him but he's real good. He's one of the better tenor men in town now today. He's been on the coast for quite…
Well now, who were some of the old time musicians that you had played with?
